headline: MADSEN MINE HITS 53.87 G/T AU AND 43.38 G/T AU — AUSTIN 904 VIRGIN PANEL OPEN AT RED LAKE (TSXV:WRLG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd. (TSXV:WRLG)
snippet: West Red Lake Gold Mines (TSXV:WRLG) reported July 7 definition drill results from its Madsen Mine in Red Lake, Ontario — highlights include 53.87 g/t Au over 3.1m and 43.38 g/t Au over 3.85m from the Austin 955 Complex (~600m depth, 12 Level) and 10.22 g/t Au over 13.35m from the Austin 904 Complex (~650m depth, 13 Level). The Austin 904 Zone is a rare ~200m × 200m intact gold panel that was never historically mined, giving West Red Lake systematic access to the full mineralized block — a grade-and-geometry combination that directly feeds near-term production planning at a mine already in commercial production.

headline: SUNDAY CREEK ANTIMONY ERUPTS: 7.9M AT 7.1% SB WITHIN 19.9 G/T AUEQ — UPPER GOLDEN DYKE CONFIRMED (TSX:SXGC)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Southern Cross Gold Consolidated (TSX:SXGC / ASX:SX2)
snippet: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated (TSX:SXGC / ASX:SX2) released July 6 results from six holes at the upper Golden Dyke prospect at its Sunday Creek Gold-Antimony Project in Victoria, Australia — the best intercept (SDDSC233) returned 7.9m at 19.9 g/t AuEq comprising 2.8 g/t Au and 7.1% Sb from 363.1m depth, confirming antimony dominance in the upper epizonal zone. China's export restrictions on antimony have made high-grade non-Chinese deposits a strategic priority; at 7.1% Sb, Sunday Creek's upper Golden Dyke is one of the highest-grade antimony intersections outside China's controlled supply chain, and the geological zonation is consistent with patterns that historically deliver high-grade gold beneath antimony-rich caps.

headline: SURFACE GRAPHITE HIT ON 3.8KM × 625M ANOMALY AT LAC GUÉRET SOUTH — ZONE 13 IS FIRST-EVER OUTCROP (TSXV:FCI)
source_name: PR Inside / First Canadian Graphite Inc. (TSXV:FCI)
snippet: First Canadian Graphite Inc. (TSXV:FCI) announced July 7 the discovery of visible high-grade graphite at surface within Zone 13 at its Lac Guéret South Project in Quebec — the first geological confirmation of mineralization on an EM conductor 3.8km long and up to 625m wide that had never been field-tested. Crews have now traced a continuous conductor over 3,157m of strike with sampling across true widths exceeding 100m; Lac Guéret South borders Nouveau Monde Graphite's Uatnan project in the Manicouagan region, placing Zone 13 in Quebec's top battery-graphite corridor at a moment when the US and EU are building non-Chinese natural graphite supply chains under critical minerals policy.

headline: FURY OPENS 2026 COMMITTEE BAY DRILL — 13 HOLES TARGET 524KOZ AT 7.85 G/T THREE BLUFFS PLUS ANTLER (TSX:FURY)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Fury Gold Mines Limited (TSX:FURY / NYSEAM:FURY)
snippet: Fury Gold Mines (TSX:FURY / NYSEAM:FURY) announced July 7 the start of its 2026 diamond drill program at the Committee Bay Project in Nunavut — approximately 5,000 metres across ~13 holes at the Three Bluffs Gold Deposit (524,000 oz Au indicated at 7.85 g/t, 720,000 oz inferred at 7.64 g/t) for infill and lateral expansion, plus three step-out holes at the Antler prospect. Committee Bay is a high-grade Nunavut system in Fury's two-asset portfolio alongside Eau Claire; the 2026 program is designed to support a resource category upgrade ahead of any economic assessment on a deposit with high-grade density comparable to Tier-1 Canadian gold systems.

headline: SPRINGER TUNGSTEN LAUNCHES 67,000M WITH 6 RIGS — Q4-2027 PRODUCTION TARGET SET, AUGUST START (TSXV:MOON)
source_name: Newswire.ca / Blue Moon Metals Inc. (TSXV:MOON / NASDAQ:BMM)
snippet: Blue Moon Metals (TSXV:MOON / NASDAQ:BMM) announced July 7 a 67,000-metre two-phase diamond drill program at its Springer Tungsten Project in Pershing County, Nevada — six rigs starting August focused on resource definition and exploration, plus re-logging and re-assaying of 18,000 metres of 1970s-80s historical General Electric drill core under NI 43-101 QA/QC. Springer already has a largely permitted 1,200 tpd flotation plant and APT circuit on site; the program is tied to a Q4-2027 production target, and the US Section 232 critical minerals designation for tungsten gives Springer strategic backing at a time when Chinese tungsten export restrictions are tightening.

headline: 9KM STRUCTURAL CORRIDOR MAPPED IN PATTERSON LAKE — WALES LAKE URANIUM SITS NEXT TO TRIPLE R AND ARROW (CSE:BLST)
source_name: PR Newswire / Blast Resources Inc. (CSE:BLST / OTCQB:BLSRF)
snippet: Blast Resources Inc. (CSE:BLST / OTCQB:BLSRF) announced July 7 the identification of a 9km-long, up to 3km-wide structural corridor at its Wales Lake Uranium Project in Saskatchewan — located on the southwest margin of the Athabasca Basin in the Patterson Lake Corridor that hosts IsoEnergy's Triple R Deposit (2.2 Mt at 1.58% U3O8) and NexGen Energy's Arrow Deposit (the largest low-cost uranium project globally, targeting up to 30 Mlbs per year of high-grade uranium). The structural corridor extends through all three of Blast's claim groups and represents the primary conduit in the Patterson Lake setting for uranium-bearing hydrothermal fluids — exactly the kind of structural architecture that defines the corridor's known high-grade uranium deposits.

headline: THREE GUARDSMEN BC COPPER GETS IP SCAN — PORPHYRY TARGET GOES SUBSURFACE AFTER HIGH-GRADE SURFACE HITS (CSE:GOH)
source_name: Investing News Network / GoldHaven Resources Corp. (CSE:GOH / OTCQB:GHVNF)
snippet: GoldHaven Resources Corp. (CSE:GOH / OTCQB:GHVNF) announced July 7 the start of a targeted induced polarization (IP) survey at its 100%-owned Three Guardsmen Project in northwestern British Columbia — a pole-dipole time-domain survey covering approximately three kilometres over priority target areas to define sulphide chargeability and resistivity anomalies at depth following the 2025 confirmation of widespread high-grade surface copper mineralization. Scott Geophysics Ltd. is executing the survey; results will directly inform drill targeting at what GoldHaven interprets as a potential porphyry copper system — the survey marks the transition from surface geology to subsurface targeting ahead of a potential drill permit application.

headline: ZORRO MAPS Cu-Ag AND Au-Ag DUAL DOMAINS ACROSS 1,719 SAMPLES — MAIDEN ARGENTINA DRILL PROGRAM NOW BEING PERMITTED (TSXV:SAE)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Sable Resources Ltd. (TSXV:SAE / OTCQB:SBLRF)
snippet: Sable Resources Ltd. (TSXV:SAE / OTCQB:SBLRF) completed July 6 a 1,719-sample soil geochemistry survey at the Zorro Project in San Juan Province, Argentina — revealing two spatially related but chemically distinct mineralized domains: a Cu-Ag (Au-Bi-W) domain in the western half and an Au-Ag-Zn (As-Pb) domain in the eastern half. The dual-domain structure is geochemically consistent with a zoned porphyry or epithermal system at depth, and Sable is now advancing permitting and logistics for a maiden diamond drill program to test the Zorro target in San Juan Province — one of Argentina's most politically stable mining jurisdictions and neighbour to the world-class Andes copper belt.

headline: ROSLAND CAPITAL BANKRUPT: 617 GOLD BUYERS OWED $60M IN UNDELIVERED METAL — SELL-FIRST MODEL FAILS AT $4K AU
snippet: Money Metals Exchange published July 6 a detailed consumer warning following Rosland Capital LLC's July 2 Chapter 11 filing in the Central District of California — the bankrupt dealer holds no inventory or meaningful cash, leaving 617 customers owed at least $60 million ($49M in deferred revenue on undelivered orders, $11.8M in buyback obligations) after operating a 'sell first, buy later' model that became unsustainable as gold surged from $1,500-$2,000 in 2023 to $5,620 at its January 2026 all-time high. The piece is a direct cautionary lesson for retail precious metals investors about counterparty risk: dealers who pre-purchase inventory before customer payment carry zero fulfillment exposure, while those who collect payment before buying pass all price-gap risk to the customer.

headline: DYNASTY DRILLS SOUTH PELHAM IP ANOMALY AT THUNDERCLOUD — CENTERRA AND ALAMOS BACK 200KOZ ONTARIO GOLD EXPANSION (TSXV:DYG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Dynasty Gold Corp. (TSXV:DYG / OTC:DGDCF)
snippet: Dynasty Gold Corp. (TSXV:DYG / OTC:DGDCF) announced July 7 that its 2026 Phase 1 drill program at the 100%-owned Thundercloud property 47km southeast of Dryden, Ontario has moved to the South Pelham target — where TC24-06 previously hit 0.8 g/t Au over 22.5m starting six metres from surface at the boundary of an induced polarization chargeability anomaly. Dynasty is backed by Centerra Gold and Alamos Gold as strategic investors and is targeting an updated NI 43-101 resource estimate in 2026 expected to show material increases from the current ~200,000 oz Pelham Zone resource — major-producer strategic backing and an active drill program at $4,100+ gold is the combination that historically precedes formal joint ventures or acquisition approaches.
